name: ThermalHiddenObject-TR: A Thermal Imaging Dataset for Concealed Metallic Object Detection
description: This dataset, ThermalHiddenObject-TR, contains annotated thermal images of concealed metallic objects (key, wrench, washer, coin) captured under diffusion-dominated conditions. The dataset is organized in YOLO format with predefined train, validation, and test splits, and includes bounding box annotations for all objects. It is designed to support benchmarking of object detection models in thermal imaging scenarios. If you use this dataset, please cite the associated research article: "Benchmarking Deep Learning-Based Object Detection Models for Concealed Metallic Object Detection Using Thermal Imaging".
